mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, total_price, payment_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentStatus})
INSERT INTO orders_item (order_id, product_id, quantity, price) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, payment_status AS paymentStatus, ordered_at AS createdAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, order_id DESC
SELECT order_id AS orderId, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, payment_status AS paymentStatus, ordered_at AS createdAt FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price AS price, p.name AS name, p.image_url AS imageUrl FROM orders_item oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
